enrichment_method.evidence: 200 µg of total protein extracts were resuspended in GNL buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.5, 0.15 M NaCl, 0.1 mM CaCl2) and loaded on aga-rose-bound GNL for enrichment (Vector Laboratories, Newark, CA, USA).

fragmentation_method.evidence: The top 15 peaks were selected for HCD fragmentation, using the following settings: fragment scan resolution 17,500, fragment scan fixed first mass at 110 m/z, AGC target of 1e5, maximum injection time 100 ms, and isolation window 4.0 m/z.
